This is one of those survivor games that are enjoyable because they are a survivor game and do nothing completely wrong. But comparing it with other survivor games that are free and/or prologues, it's below anticipated standards. Upgrades are horribly unbalanced. At this point, there is only one viable build. And the meta-progress is there, very bare-bones, but it feels useless unless you get the important in-game upgrades. Also, the opposition, different in size and shape, acts like zombies. They all act the same, even bosses. For people who are not spoiled by premium survivor games, assumed amount of moderate joy is 1,6-4 hours. If you are spoiled, definitely not recommended.

Free survivors-like game, could be nice but it's really limited, with a lethargic pace and no real sense of getting more powerful. In a couple hours you'll have seen and done everything there is to it. No point in grinding for hours and defeat literally millions of enemies, if what you'll get from it are just cosmetic skins that don't do anything in-game.

It is all in all a pretty useless game that tells a message about pollution in the sea. It plays very simple. You run around the sea bottom like a chicken without a head while being attacked by just about everything. Do i recommend this pointless simple to play game? Yes i would. It is free and it has something addictive, i keep coming back once a day. RECOMMENDED!
